# Terminal

A working console: surface-inverse, JetBrains Mono 13/20, selectable output, a real input line.

`PhantomPortals.Terminal` · Technical

## Use

```jsx
<PhantomPortals.Terminal title={…} lines={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="PhantomPortals.Terminal" title="{{…}}" lines="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Working console. Pass real output only; omit onCommand when the shell can't accept input.
